items.title: Multidimensional evidence map of sport science and medicine research in highly trained, elite and world-class female athletes: a scoping review
items.summary: A comprehensive scoping review of 3,867 records (1970–2025) on sport science and medicine research in highly trained female athletes found persistent gaps in participant representation, geographical coverage, and health-related themes like pelvic floor and breast health.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查清晰地绘制了针对高水平女性运动员的运动科学与医学研究图谱，揭示了研究空白。如果你在治疗女性运动员，这个图谱能帮你找到现有证据，并提醒你盆底健康、乳房健康和围绝经期研究的不足。
items.titleZh: 高水平、精英及世界级女性运动员运动科学与医学研究的多维度证据图谱：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 3,867 份记录（1970–2025 年）的范围综述绘制了高水平女性运动员运动科学与医学研究图谱，发现参与者代表性、地理覆盖以及盆底健康、乳房健康等主题仍存在研究空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review clearly maps the landscape of sport science and medicine research for highly trained female athletes, highlighting existing gaps. If you treat female athletes, this map helps you locate current evidence and alerts you to the deficiencies in research on pelvic floor health, breast health, and perimenopause.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，通过对既有文献的归纳总结，不涉及原始数据分析或效应量计算，其价值在于识别研究趋势和空白。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review that synthesizes existing literature without original data analysis or effect size calculations; its value lies in identifying research trends and gaps.

items.title: Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency - Health practitioners on notice over unmanaged conflicts of interest
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (Ahpra) and National Boards have issued new interim guidance on managing financial or commercial conflicts of interest for registered health practitioners, reminding them to prioritize patient best interests and comply with professional obligations.
items.curatedReason: 澳大利亚 AHPRA 发布了关于医疗从业者管理利益冲突的新指南，强调了财务或商业利益可能对临床决策产生的潜在影响。如果你在澳大利亚执业，务必审视自己的业务模式和转诊关系，确保所有行为都符合职业道德规范，以患者最佳利益为先。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构：健康从业者须警惕未管理的利益冲突
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚健康从业者监管机构（Ahpra）和国家委员会发布了关于管理注册健康从业者财务或商业利益冲突的最新临时指南，提醒从业者必须将患者的最佳利益置于首位，并遵守职业义务。
items.curatedReasonEn: AHPRA in Australia has issued new guidance on managing conflicts of interest for healthcare practitioners, emphasizing the potential impact of financial or commercial interests on clinical decision-making. If you practice in Australia, you must review your business models and referral relationships to ensure all actions comply with professional ethics and prioritize the patient's best interests.

items.title: The load-velocity profile as a muscle quality index and fall risk predictor in older adults: a multifactorial perspective (PhD Academy Award).
items.summary: A PhD award study introduces the load-velocity profile as a muscle quality index and fall risk predictor in older adults, offering a multifactorial perspective on fall prevention.
items.curatedReason: 本博士奖项研究提出了以负荷-速度曲线作为肌肉质量指标和跌倒风险预测因子，为老年人跌倒预防和干预提供了新的生物力学评估视角。将其整合到临床评估路径，能更精细地识别高风险个体。
items.titleZh: 负荷-速度曲线作为老年人肌肉质量指标和跌倒风险预测因子：多因素视角（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士奖项研究提出，负荷-速度曲线可作为老年人肌肉质量指标和跌倒风险预测因子，为跌倒预防提供了多因素视角。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD award study proposes the load-velocity profile as a muscle quality index and fall risk predictor, offering a new biomechanical assessment perspective for fall prevention and intervention in older adults. Integrating this into clinical assessment pathways can help identify high-risk individuals more precisely.
items.limitation: 该研究属于博士奖项摘要，未提供完整的样本量、研究设计和效应量细节，尚待全面评估其临床推断强度和外推性。
items.limitationEn: As a PhD award abstract, the study lacks full details on sample size, study design, and effect sizes, requiring a comprehensive evaluation of its clinical inference strength and generalizability.

items.title: Associations of physical, psychosocial and dual-career loads with injury and illness occurrence among elite handball players (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD award study investigated how physical, psychosocial, and dual-career loads contribute to injury and illness in elite handball players, adopting a biopsychosocial perspective beyond traditional physical injury etiology models.
items.curatedReason: 对于精英手球运动员的伤病评估，不要仅限于体能负荷。这项研究提示，物理、心理社会及双重职业（学业/工作）压力对伤病有显著影响，我们需要更全面地考虑多重压力源，而非只关注生物力学因素。
items.titleZh: 精英手球运动员身体、心理社会及双重职业负荷与伤病发生率的关联（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士奖项研究探讨了精英手球运动员身体、心理社会及双重职业负荷与伤病发生率的关联，突破传统身体损伤病因学模型，采用生物心理社会视角。
items.curatedReasonEn: When assessing injuries in elite handball players, do not limit your focus to physical load. This study suggests that physical, psychosocial, and dual-career loads significantly contribute to injury and illness, requiring us to consider multiple stressors more comprehensively, rather than just biomechanical factors.
items.limitation: 该研究为博士论文摘要，未提供完整的样本量、研究设计和效应量细节，且聚焦于特定运动项目，外推至其他运动项目的适用性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD thesis abstract, lacking full details on sample size, study design, and effect sizes. Its focus on a specific sport means generalizability to other sports should be considered with caution.

items.title: Muscle injuries in football: integrating structural and neuromuscular outcomes to minimise reinjury risk and enhance post-injury performance (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: A PhD award study integrated seven sub-studies on muscle injuries in football, focusing on minimizing reinjury risk and enhancing post-injury performance by integrating structural and neuromuscular outcomes, and investigating return-to-play criteria and on-field rehabilitation exposure.
items.curatedReason: 足球运动员肌肉损伤后的康复，不应只关注结构恢复。这项综述强调，整合肌肉结构与神经肌肉功能评估，并精细化重返赛场标准和场上康复负荷，是降低再损伤风险、提升表现的关键策略。
items.titleZh: 足球运动员肌肉损伤：整合结构与神经肌肉结局以最小化再损伤风险并提升伤后表现（博士学院奖）
items.summaryZh: 一项博士奖项研究整合了足球运动员肌肉损伤的七项子研究，侧重通过结合结构和神经肌肉结局来最小化再损伤风险并提升伤后表现，并探讨了重返赛场标准和场上康复训练暴露。
items.curatedReasonEn: Rehabilitation for muscle injuries in football players should not focus solely on structural recovery. This review emphasizes that integrating muscle structural and neuromuscular functional assessments, along with refining return-to-play criteria and on-field rehabilitation loads, are key strategies to minimize reinjury risk and enhance performance.
items.limitation: 本研究为博士论文摘要，由七个子研究整合而成，但未提供各子研究的具体设计、样本量和效应量细节，全面评估其证据等级需查阅完整论文。
items.limitationEn: This is a PhD thesis abstract, integrating seven sub-studies, but lacks specific details on the design, sample size, and effect sizes of each sub-study. A full assessment of its evidence level requires consulting the complete thesis.

items.title: Evaluation of an eHealth Assistive Device Provision Training Tool: A Quasi-Experimental Study
items.summary: A quasi-experimental pre-post study (n=33) found that the WHO Training in Assistive Products (TAP) eHealth module demonstrated above-average usability (76.97 ± 9.66) and favorable acceptability, significantly improving health science students' self-efficacy in mobility aid provision from 2.32 ± 0.58 to 4.23 ± 0.36 (p < 0.001).
items.curatedReason: 这项准实验研究显示，WHO 的辅助产品培训（TAP）电子健康模块能显著提高健康科学学生的自我效能。这意味着在实践中，这类在线工具可以作为培训康复专业人员的有效补充，尤其是在弥补全球劳动力培训缺口方面。
items.titleZh: 电子健康辅助设备提供培训工具的评估：一项准实验研究
items.summaryZh: 一项准实验前瞻性研究（n=33）发现，WHO 辅助产品培训（TAP）电子健康模块的可用性高于平均水平（76.97 ± 9.66），可接受度良好，并显著提升了健康科学学生在移动辅助设备提供方面的自我效能，从 2.32 ± 0.58 提高到 4.23 ± 0.36 (p < 0.001)。
items.curatedReasonEn: This quasi-experimental study demonstrates that the WHO Training in Assistive Products (TAP) eHealth module significantly improves self-efficacy among health science students. This suggests that in practice, such online tools can effectively supplement the training of rehabilitation professionals, especially in bridging global workforce training gaps.
items.limitation: 本研究为准实验设计，样本量相对较小（n=33），且仅评估了自我效能这一替代终点，未直接测量实际能力提升或患者结局改善。
items.limitationEn: This quasi-experimental study has a relatively small sample size (n=33) and only assessed self-efficacy as a surrogate endpoint, without directly measuring actual skill improvement or patient outcome enhancement.

items.title: Turf toe: an occupational hazard in football players
items.summary: A case report describes a 23-year-old collegiate male football player presenting with acute right great toe pain and a high-grade plantar plate ('turf toe') injury following a hyperextension injury on natural turf, diagnosed by radiographs and 3T MRI.
items.curatedReason: 这篇病例报告详细描述了美式足球运动员的“草皮趾”损伤案例，强调了其作为高水平橄榄球运动员的常见职业危害。这对你诊断和管理高能量足部损伤，特别是第一跖趾关节（MTPJ）过度伸展伤，提供了临床细节参考。
items.titleZh: 草皮趾：足球运动员的职业危害
items.summaryZh: 一篇病例报告描述了一名 23 岁大学美式足球运动员在天然草皮上因足趾过伸伤导致右足大趾急性疼痛，经 X 光和 3T MRI 诊断为高等级跖板（“草皮趾”）损伤。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report details a 'turf toe' injury in an American football player, highlighting it as a common occupational hazard for high-level athletes. This provides clinical detail for your diagnosis and management of high-energy foot injuries, especially first metatarsophalangeal joint (MTPJ) hyperextension injuries.
items.limitation: 本研究为单病例报告，结论无法外推到更广泛的人群或作为普遍临床指导。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report, and its conclusions cannot be generalized to a broader population or serve as universal clinical guidance.

items.title: The acceptability of and adherence to a high-dose walking booster program after stroke (HiWalk): a multi-method study of stroke survivors' experiences nested within a randomised controlled trial.
items.summary: A multi-method study nested within a Phase II randomized trial (HiWalk) found a high-dose walking booster program was acceptable to stroke survivors, with participants attending 91% of sessions and averaging 567 repetitions per hour. Key facilitators included opportunity, motivation, and support, while fatigue and competing responsibilities were barriers.
items.curatedReason: 这项多方法研究提示，高剂量步行强化训练对卒中幸存者是可接受的，且依从性高。尽管存在疲劳和生活责任等障碍，但患者仍有很强的参与动机，并认为其有价值。
items.titleZh: 卒中后高剂量步行强化训练项目（HiWalk）的可接受性和依从性：一项巢式多方法研究
items.summaryZh: 一项巢式多方法研究（HiWalk）发现，高剂量步行强化训练项目对卒中幸存者具有可接受性，参与者出勤率达 91%，平均每小时重复 567 次。主要促进因素包括机会、动机和支持，而疲劳和 competing responsibilities 是障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This multi-method study suggests that a high-dose walking booster program is acceptable to stroke survivors, with high adherence rates. Despite barriers like fatigue and competing life responsibilities, participants were highly motivated and found the program worthwhile.
items.limitation: 本研究为嵌套在 II 期随机试验中的多方法研究，侧重于可接受性和依从性，缺乏长期疗效数据。
items.limitationEn: This multi-method study, nested within a Phase II randomized trial, focuses on acceptability and adherence, lacking long-term efficacy data.

items.title: Medicare Advantage and Medicare Prescription Drug Programs Expected to Remain Stable in 2027
items.summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) projects that Medicare Advantage and Medicare Prescription Drug Programs will remain stable in 2027, indicating no major shifts in program structure or benefits.
items.curatedReason: CMS 预计 2027 年 Medicare Advantage 和处方药计划将保持稳定，这对 PT 执业的未来报销环境具有基础性意义。
items.titleZh: Medicare Advantage 和 Medicare 处方药计划预计 2027 年保持稳定
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心 (CMS) 预计，Medicare Advantage 和 Medicare 处方药计划在 2027 年将保持稳定，这表明计划结构或福利不会发生重大变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS expects Medicare Advantage and prescription drug programs to remain stable in 2027, which is foundational for the future reimbursement environment of PT practice.

items.title: Five years on, NO PROGRESS: the gender equity crisis in sport and exercise medicine publishing persists - action is now overdue
items.summary: A new analysis of the top 50 SCImago-ranked journals for sports medicine and physical therapy reveals that gender inequity in publishing has stagnated over the past five years, with women representing only 33% of first authors, unchanged since 2019.
items.curatedReason: 运动和锻炼医学出版物中的性别不平等问题依然存在，自 2019 年以来没有改善，女性作者的比例停滞在三分之一左右。这表明行业在促进公平方面进展缓慢。
items.titleZh: 五年无进展：运动和锻炼医学出版领域的性别平等危机持续，亟待行动
items.summaryZh: 一项针对运动医学和物理治疗领域排名前 50 的 SCImago 期刊的新分析显示，过去五年出版领域的性别不平等问题停滞不前，女性第一作者的比例仍为 33%，自 2019 年以来没有变化。
items.curatedReasonEn: Gender inequity in sport and exercise medicine publishing persists with no improvement since 2019, as the proportion of women authors remains stagnant at around one-third. This highlights slow progress in promoting equity within the profession.

items.title: Optimal exercise dose in adults with chronic low back pain disorders: systematic review with dose-response network meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of 239 trials found that low-to-moderate doses of exercise were associated with short-term, clinically meaningful improvements in disability and pain intensity for adults with chronic low back pain, with limited additional benefit at higher exposure. Optimal doses were model-predicted as 4 sessions/week, 25 min/session over 13 weeks for disability, and 3 sessions/week, 30 min/session over 8 weeks for pain.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性下腰痛患者，运动处方应聚焦中低剂量，以期在短期内实现残疾和疼痛的临床有意义改善。超出这个范围，比如每周超过 4 次、每次超过 25 分钟、持续超过 13 周，额外获益有限，没必要盲目加量。
items.titleZh: 慢性下腰痛患者运动最佳剂量：剂量-反应网络 Meta 分析系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 239 项试验的系统综述和网络 Meta 分析发现，中低剂量的运动训练能为慢性下腰痛患者带来短期残疾和疼痛的临床有意义改善，但高剂量额外获益有限。模型预测的残疾最佳剂量为每周 4 次、每次 25 分钟、持续 13 周；疼痛最佳剂量为每周 3 次、每次 30 分钟、持续 8 周。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic low back pain, exercise prescriptions should target low-to-moderate doses for clinically meaningful short-term improvements in disability and pain. Additional benefits are limited at higher doses—e.g., beyond 4 sessions/week, 25 min/session, or 13 weeks duration—so avoid unnecessary intensity escalation.
items.limitation: 该综述纳入的大多数试验（84%）存在高偏倚风险，且证据确定性为极低到低。
items.limitationEn: The majority of trials included (84%) had a high risk of bias, and the certainty of evidence was very low to low.

items.title: Exercise-only interventions and exercise-based multidomain lifestyle interventions to promote cognitive function in older adults without dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 227 studies found that exercise-only interventions significantly improved executive functions, memory, and processing speed in older adults without dementia compared to control. Exercise-plus interventions (exercise combined with other lifestyle interventions, most commonly cognitive training) were significantly better than control for memory, and better than exercise-only for executive functions and processing speed.
items.curatedReason: 对于无痴呆老年人，将运动作为改善认知功能（特别是执行功能、记忆和处理速度）的首选干预是毋庸置疑的。如果条件允许，联合认知训练能进一步提升执行功能和处理速度。
items.titleZh: 运动干预和基于运动的多领域生活方式干预对无痴呆老年人认知功能的影响：系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 227 项研究的系统综述和 Meta 分析发现，单独运动干预与对照组相比，能显著改善无痴呆老年人的执行功能、记忆和处理速度。多领域干预（运动结合其他生活方式干预，最常见的是认知训练）在改善记忆方面显著优于对照组，并在执行功能和处理速度方面优于单独运动。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults without dementia, exercise is unequivocally the first-line intervention for improving cognitive function, especially executive functions, memory, and processing speed. When feasible, combining exercise with cognitive training can further enhance executive functions and processing speed.
items.limitation: 研究未详细报告多领域干预中各类“加成”成分的具体效果差异，需要进一步研究来明确其额外益处。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the specific effects of different 'plus' components in multi-domain interventions, requiring further research to determine their added benefit.

items.title: Establishing Consensus for Prescription of Prosthetic Components for Transtibial Bone-Anchored Limbs: An International Delphi Method Study
items.summary: An international Delphi method study established consensus and provided recommendations from experts on the prescription of prosthetic components for patients with transtibial bone-anchored limbs (BAL).
items.curatedReason: 这份国际专家共识为胫骨骨锚式假肢的部件选择提供了宝贵参考。对于这类复杂患者，直接应用这些推荐能指导你做出更精准的假肢配置决策，从而优化患者的功能预后和使用体验。
items.titleZh: 建立胫骨骨锚式假肢组件处方国际共识：一项 Delphi 方法学研究
items.summaryZh: 一项国际 Delphi 方法学研究就胫骨骨锚式假肢（BAL）患者的假肢组件处方达成专家共识并提出了建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This international expert consensus study provides specific recommendations for prosthetic component prescription for transtibial bone-anchored limbs. For PTs who fit prostheses for these complex cases, this guideline will directly impact your clinical decision-making and prosthesis selection, enhancing patient function and adherence.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training improves proprioception and dynamic balance in female karatekas with flatfoot: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=34) found that combining three-dimensional ankle exercises with short-foot training (SF-3DAE) led to greater improvements in navicular drop (2.24 mm vs 1.16 mm), ankle proprioception (3° vs 1.59° error reduction), and dynamic balance (17.49% vs 7.82% Y-Balance reach increase) in female karatekas with flatfoot, compared to short-foot exercise alone.
items.curatedReason: 有扁平足的空手道女运动员，加用三维踝关节训练能显著改善足弓、本体感觉和动态平衡，相比单一的足底短肌训练效果更优。在处理有足部生物力学异常的运动员时，可以考虑整合多平面踝关节训练。
items.titleZh: 三维踝关节训练联合足底短肌训练可改善扁平足空手道女运动员的本体感觉和动态平衡：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=34）发现，对于扁平足的空手道女运动员，三维踝关节训练联合足底短肌训练（SF-3DAE）在改善舟骨下降（下降 2.24 mm vs 1.16 mm）、踝关节本体感觉（误差减少 3° vs 1.59°）和动态平衡（Y-Balance 增加 17.49% vs 7.82%）方面，比单独的足底短肌训练效果更优。
items.curatedReasonEn: For female karatekas with flatfoot, adding 3D ankle exercises significantly improves foot arch, proprioception, and dynamic balance compared to short-foot exercises alone. Consider integrating multi-planar ankle training for athletes with foot biomechanical abnormalities.
items.limitation: 本研究的SF-3DAE组接受了更多的监督训练量，因此不能完全排除训练总量效应的影响。
items.limitationEn: The SF-3DAE group in this study received a greater volume of supervised exercise, so the effect of total training volume cannot be entirely excluded.
items.journal: Physical therapy in sport : official journal of the Association of Chartered Physiotherapists in Sports Medicine

items.title: Beliefs and Practices of Pediatric Physiotherapists in Türkiye Regarding Early Mobility and Crawling.
items.summary: An online survey of 109 pediatric physiotherapists in Türkiye revealed that 94.5% believed crawling was important and linked it to positive developmental outcomes. 63% opposed removing crawling from CDC checklists, influencing their clinical practices to train hands-and-knees crawling when appropriate.
items.curatedReason: 土耳其的儿科物理治疗师普遍认为爬行很重要，并将其与多项发展结果联系起来。尽管美国 CDC 移除了爬行里程碑，但多数治疗师仍支持在临床适当情况下训练爬行。这提醒您在临床实践中，要平衡主流观点与最新指南，并基于个体儿童需求进行决策。
items.titleZh: 土耳其儿科物理治疗师关于早期移动能力和爬行的信念与实践
items.summaryZh: 一项对土耳其 109 名儿科物理治疗师的在线调查显示，94.5% 的人认为爬行很重要，并将其与积极的发展结果联系起来。63% 的人反对将爬行从 CDC 里程碑清单中删除，这影响了他们在临床上适当时进行手膝爬行训练的做法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Pediatric physical therapists in Türkiye largely view crawling as important and link it to various developmental outcomes. Despite the CDC removing crawling milestones, most therapists still support crawling training when clinically appropriate. This reminds you to balance prevailing views with current guidelines in practice and make decisions based on individual child needs.
items.limitation: 该研究的发现仅基于土耳其的儿科物理治疗师，其结果对其他文化背景或医疗系统的外推性可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The findings of this study are based solely on pediatric physical therapists in Türkiye, and their generalizability to other cultural contexts or healthcare systems may be limited.
